age.evidence: For our transcriptomic analysis, we re-examined bulk RNA-Seq data from the retina and RPE of 1-month AdipoR1−/− and WT mice.

Eyeballs from albino AdipoR1−/− mice and albino B6 WT mice (strain 000058, The Jackson Laboratory) approximately 1-month (PND 31–38; n = 2 for each genotype) were collected post-euthanasia and dissected in PBS (136.9 mM NaCl, 2.7 mM KCl, 8.1 mM Na2HPO4, 1.5 mM KH2PO4).
